nodes.label: FastConnect covered-window restoration
nodes.rationale: A transient system overlay removed DockActivity from the foreground; bounded restoration addresses that case.

nodes.label: Independent charging and Always On switches
nodes.rationale: The two options preserve separate consent and activation conditions.

nodes.label: Native Kotlin and Compose architecture
nodes.rationale: Android system integrations would require bridges in cross-platform UI stacks.

nodes.label: minSdk 26 candidate
nodes.rationale: Supports java.time directly, but requires validation on older firmware; proposal only.

nodes.label: targetSdk 36 for prototype
nodes.rationale: Matches the local SDK and tested Android 16 device; publication value remains open.

nodes.label: Shared DockScreen for Activity and DreamService
nodes.rationale: Both hosts render the same saved configuration.

nodes.label: Shared DockScreen architecture
nodes.rationale: A common screen and saved model keep the two hosts aligned.

nodes.label: Reversible editor draft
nodes.rationale: Saving applies changes while Cancel and Back discard the draft.

nodes.label: Serialized charging events
nodes.rationale: Serial processing keeps charging transitions ordered.

nodes.label: WAIT_FOR_USE transition
nodes.rationale: A stopped display waits for observed phone use before another StandBy launch.

nodes.label: LAUNCHING SCREEN_ON handling
nodes.rationale: A screen wake caused by the app must not count as user activity.
